ablation_panel_note: Not separately checked: this project's controlled ablation panels use small numbers (<20 total across all rounds) of extremely common, simple reference molecules (pyridine, octane, cyclohexane, benzene, morpholine, etc.) embedded directly in analysis scripts, not sourced from any external corpus.
